posts.name: Melkhor
posts.cooked:
Near Mint for me here. I made some key errors and misplays during my first attempt that led to me being swarmed and utterly destroyed by Sergeant Steel and Ambuscade with no recovery possible.

Second game went much, much better, however, with everyone still standing at the end, Ra and Legacy in their low teens and Absolute Zero hovering down around 5 or 6 HP.

Took down Sergeant Steel first, followed by Anvil, Hammer and finally Ambuscade so I didn't have to deal with the remaining members of the Slaughterhouse Six.

posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

Flesh of the Sun God, Coolant Blast, and two serious, mega-Scorched Earths did the trick.

 

Ra only survivor at 4HP.  Needed to discard the crystal that AZ picked up to direct the Behemoth's Melee damage to the Tunneler, otherwise it would have been a loss. The Behemoth took out both AZ and Legacy after the redirect. Ra had enough flame-juice to take out Ambuscade for the win after that.

 

I used Subzero atmosphere...but only for one round. It makes Ambuscade automatically play extra cards. Didn't like that, so AZ used it to power up his own Fueled Freeze.

posts.name: rasellman
posts.cooked:
I had a different take on dealing with Glamour. 

I used her to bounce cold damage off the nemesis to heal Absolute Zero multiple times per turn with Thermal Shockwave. 

Between Flesh of the Sun God from Ra, Legacy boosting damage, and the ability to bounce the cold damage off the nemeses I was able to heal AZ up over 10 per turn with no downside since the fire damage from Thermal Shockwave was cancelled. 

I did have to play the Null Point each turn sometimes via Modular Realignment, but AZ took the other damage leaving Ra to clean up via Scorched Earth.

Resulted in Mint with no one disabled.
